comment: A high-speed stream from a coronal hole (CH) is expected to arrive today. This is a non-recurrent CH so there is some uncertainty in the magnitude of any resulting geomagnetic activity but there may be intervals of up to STORM G1. In the second forecast window, solar wind parameters should decline towards background levels bringing overall QUIET conditions. There were two filament eruptions with associated coronal mass ejections (CMEs) observed yesterday 10-Sep, as well as a faint, slow CME on 9-Sep. These may have Earth-directed components, with potential glancing impact on 14-Sep so there is a chance of ACTIVE spells if these start to become geoeffective in the latter half of the third period.
role: independent advisory; score_effect=0 until prospective validation
